title: HyQBench: A Benchmark Suite for Hybrid CV-DV Quantum Computing
summary: Hybrid continuous-variable (CV)-discrete-variable (DV) quantum systems present a promising direction for quantum computing by combining the high dimensional encoding capabilities of qumodes with the control offered by DV qubits on the coupled qumodes. There have been exciting recent progresses on hybrid CV-DV quantum computing, including variational algorithms, error correction, compiler-level optimizations for Hamiltonian simulation, etc. However, there is a lack of a standardized CV-DV benchmark suite for assessing various emerging hardware platforms and evaluating software optimizations…
